title: Use a modern 2D character design + retro editorial illustration style with…
content: Use a modern 2D character design + retro editorial illustration style with exaggerated proportions, geometric shapes, warm muted colors, and a textured gouache finish to get funny, absurd basketball scenes in Seedance 2.5.
